generator: tools/motion_vectors/generate.py (copy of the local_retract cases of docs/motion/vectors.json for the backend CI image)

cases.description: Bolt in a fixed plate hole (concentric + end face): the free motion is the spin about the hole axis; a spin wish is ON the manifold, the retraction must return it exactly (fallback = the wish, as the projector reproduces it)
Pull the bolt 15 mm off the plate while spinning 20 deg: nearest mate-satisfying pose = back on the face, spun 20 deg
Slide the bolt 6/-3 mm sideways out of the hole: nearest = back on the axis (the grabbed pose stays ~1e-4 relative short of the wish)
Off-axis pin (axis 15 mm from the part origin, the CURVED mate of the investigation): a 4 deg turn of the part about its own origin is off the manifold; the retraction lands on the pin's orbit
Same pin, a 90 deg wish in one frame (an unrealistic hitch): the retraction converges but far (12 weighted mm) from the fallback pose; the distance guard rejects it and the fallback is shown
Angle mate 60 deg: tilting the part 3 deg further is off the cone; nearest = back on the cone
Angle mate: a spin about the cone axis (world z) keeps the angle: on the manifold, reproduced exactly
Distance mate 7 to a plane: wish 9 mm out -> nearest 7 mm (signed-squared residual, either side)
Nothing fixed (bolt AND plate move): a 3 deg turn of the grabbed bolt about x, the plate's wish is its current pose; both land on the manifold
Floating group: slide 4 mm along x and spin 10 deg: the plate rides along (minimal motion)
Floating group, 60 deg in one frame: with the hitch iterations it converges, but lands more than 0.5 max(L, d_wish) from the fallback: rejected
Floating group, 90 deg about y in one frame (a hitch the 8 iterations do not finish: residual > 1e-6): rejected, fallback shown
Concentric without rotation + end face: rank 6, no free motion; any wish returns the start
The local answer converges but lies more than 0.5 L from the fallback (a far projector output): rejected, fallback shown

5 boxes in a row on a plate, faces mated (group dof 3: slide x, y, spin z as one rigid row): the first box is slid 3 mm and turned 2 deg - the whole row must follow, 4 residual rows per mate (36 rows)
5-box row: the first box is lifted 2 mm off the plate and slid 3 mm - the lift is blocked, the slide drags the row

8 boxes in a row on a plate, faces mated (group dof 3: slide x, y, spin z as one rigid row): the first box is slid 3 mm and turned 2 deg - the whole row must follow, 4 residual rows per mate (60 rows)
8-box row: the first box is lifted 2 mm off the plate and slid 3 mm - the lift is blocked, the slide drags the row
